_note: A dividend is income from other sources (D-194; rulebook OS-DIV-001), taxed at the slab rates with the rest of total income. TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.92(2)(a) "any dividend" (p.138). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.56(2)(i) "dividends" (thc p.303). Deductions against it: OS-DIVIDEND-INTEREST, OS-DEEMED-DIVIDEND. Every regime.
